name: org2html-floor-proof
description: A minimal consumer that installs @kyonax/org2html from the registry and builds the corpus. It exists to prove the package's OWN declared Node floor (>=18.13.0) on every supported major, which the blog itself cannot do: the blog's Vite toolchain requires >=20.19.

scripts.proof: org2html build ../corpus -o out --include-root ../../includes --base-url https://kyonax.com/blog --asset-base /blog && node ../copy-media.mjs ../../media out/media && node ../assert-build.mjs out --corpus --origin https://kyonax.com --base-path /blog && node ../feature-surface.mjs
